title: What One Novanta Means to Me
summary: People often ask whether One Novanta is a program or a framework. While it influences many of our decisions, I think of it differently. One Novanta is a mindset. It is a shared commitment to look beyond our individual teams, sites, business units, and functions and recognize that we are all contributing to something bigger than ourselves.
body_markdown:
As organizations grow, they often face a challenge that goes beyond products, markets, or even operations.


How do you preserve connection while expanding?


It is a question I’ve thought about often as I’ve watched our company evolve. We’ve[added capabilities and expanded our global footprint](https://novanta.com/about/partnering-for-progress/) , welcoming talented teams from around the world. With growth comes tremendous opportunity, but it also requires intention.


That is why the idea of **One Novanta** has become increasingly important.


One Novanta is not a corporate initiative or a formal framework. It is a way of thinking about how we work together.


It starts with a simple belief: Our greatest strength comes from the collective expertise of our people.


Across our organization, employees bring deep technical knowledge and unique perspectives. Individually, those strengths are valuable. Together, they become a powerful advantage for customers.


That is where One Novanta comes to life.


It is present when[teams collaborate across functions to solve complex problems](https://novanta.com/careers-culture/life-at-novanta/) . It appears when employees share insights across sites and business units. It grows when people look beyond organizational boundaries and focus on achieving the best possible outcome.


In many ways, One Novanta reflects the reality that innovation rarely happens in isolation.


The most meaningful breakthroughs are often the result of collaboration. They emerge from conversations that challenge assumptions and inspire new approaches.


As our organization continues to evolve, maintaining that spirit of collaboration becomes even more important.


We want customers to experience our company as a connected partner. We want employees to feel empowered to share ideas and learn from one another. We want our teams to see opportunities beyond their immediate responsibilities and contribute to the broader success of the organization.


That vision is what One Novanta represents.


It is a commitment to building connections and creating alignment while leveraging the collective strength of our[global organization.](https://novanta.com/about/our-locations/)


Most importantly, it is something that belongs to all of us.


Every employee contributes to shaping what One Novanta looks like through the relationships they build and the challenges they help solve, as well as the ways they collaborate across the company.


When we work together with that mindset, we create something greater than the sum of our individual parts.


That is the power of One Novanta.


***By: Cari Rutkoskie, Vice President of Communications***
